column1: # Module 09 — eval harness mini. Format: Question¶{{c1::direct answer}}<TAB>Extra(explanation)<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What are an eval's three irreducible parts?¶{{c1::Fixed tasks}} + {{c1::a scoring method}} + {{c1::blindness}}
column2: Blindness = the discipline not to peek.

column1: What are the two eval scoring families?¶{{c1::Programmatic}} · {{c1::rubric}}
column2: Programmatic: a checker decides (exact/tests/regex). Rubric: a human grades blind against written criteria.

column1: Why must rubric grading be blind?¶{{c1::You WILL favour the model you expect to win}}
column2: Shuffling + anonymising is the only honest fix.

column1: What are the four properties of a good eval task?¶{{c1::Representative}} · {{c1::one skill per task}} · {{c1::verifiable}} · {{c1::crisply stated}}
column2: Crisply stated = a wrong answer can't blame the prompt.

column1: What is contamination in an eval?¶{{c1::The answer exists as memorised text}}
column2: Famous puzzles measure recall of the internet, not capability.

column1: Why is n=1 an anecdote when evaluating models?¶{{c1::Models are stochastic — single runs are noise}}
column2: Patterns across task FAMILIES are the signal.

column1: What does a per-family subtotal reveal that the total hides?¶{{c1::The capability profile}}
column2: A model can win code and lose writing — jagged intelligence, measured.

column1: Model X felt smarter — what is the engineering translation?¶{{c1::No measurement occurred. Run the harness}}
In module 09's 9–9 dead-heat fixture, what was the lesson?¶{{c1::Equal totals with OPPOSITE profiles — the winner depends on the JOB}}
column2: A followed output contracts exactly; B explained better but ignored instructions.

column1: Why did fixture-B fail four programmatic tasks despite correct answers?¶{{c1::Extra prose around a correct answer still fails an exact-match contract}}
Why write "reply with ONLY the number" in eval prompts?¶{{c1::The output contract makes programmatic checking possible}}
column2: Eval design and prompt design are the same skill.

column1: What four things would make an eval harness lie to you?¶{{c1::Contaminated tasks}} · {{c1::leading/ambiguous prompts}} · {{c1::unblinded grading}} · {{c1::reading n=1 noise as signal}}
What is the criteria-vs-vibes test?¶{{c1::A stranger applying your criteria reaches your score}}
column2: Is it good? fails that instantly.

column1: Module 09's eval method reapplies unchanged to which two bigger surfaces?¶{{c1::Agents}} · {{c1::RAG}}
column2: Same method, bigger surface (Tier 3–4 of the plan).
